video_history.why: No video ads ran in the last 90 days (all 10 campaigns with impressions are Search), so there is no hook or hold rate to learn from. The scripts below are the first test, and their hooks come from step 2.

search_language.why_180_days: The 90-day window had only 69 clicks on visible search terms, under the 100-click floor, so the window was widened.

examples: i need a lawyer and i have no money
how to get a pardon for a felony in [state]
how to beat a dui in [state]
how do you get out of a dui

excluded.why: brand terms and terms that name a person, another firm or an unlisted place; never quoted

search_language.read: 'Local and near me' searches carry the most visible conversions (14.0). Three themes tie next at 7.0 conversions each: cost and payment, court and process, and license. Cost and payment has the most clicks of the three (26) and spans 18 different searches, including people asking for lawyers who take payments: the clearest buying worry to answer in a video.

ad_lines.rule: lines with 1,000+ impressions ranked by conversions per 1,000 impressions; lines under 1,000 that beat the top line of their type are listed as promising; lines from another practice are left out; conversions are shared credit across every line that served in a converting ad

scripts.name: Script A: the cost worry
scripts.angle: Cost is what stops people calling, so answer it first: payment plans, a free evaluation, and call or text any time.
evidence: cost and payment searches: 18 terms, 26 clicks
top headline: 'Call or text 24×7 | Free Eval' (17.8 conversions per 1,000 impressions)

beats.voiceover: Arrested for DUI and worried what a lawyer will cost?
beats.visual: Attorney at a desk, eye level, looks straight at camera. Firm name lower third from 0:01.
beats.direction: Calm and direct, no smile on the first line. Say it before the skip button.

beats.voiceover: Don't let the price stop you from calling.
beats.visual: Close-up: a phone with a missed call, then a hand picking it up.
on_screen_text: Don't let the price stop you calling

beats.voiceover: We offer flexible payment plans, and your first case evaluation is free. Call or text us any time.
beats.visual: Cut to the attorney with a client at a table; then a phone screen showing a text conversation starting.
beats.direction: Three cards; each lands on the matching words.

beats.voiceover: [N]+ clients have given us five-star reviews.
beats.visual: Scrolling review stars on screen (real reviews, names hidden).

beats.voiceover: Call or text now for your free case evaluation.
beats.visual: Attorney to camera; phone number and firm name full screen for the last 3 seconds.
on_screen_text: Call or text: [phone] | Attorney advertising [state disclaimer]
beats.direction: Point to the number. Hold the end card 2 seconds.

specs.cta: Call or text for a free case evaluation

DUI lawyers who take payments? We do.
hook_variants.evidence: search for lawyers that take payments; payment-plan headline

hook_variants.hook: Don't wait on a DUI because of money.
hook_variants.evidence: search 'i need a lawyer and i have no money'; payment-plan headline

scripts.name: Script B: what's at stake
scripts.angle: Name the stakes (license, job), then say what the firm aims for.
evidence: top description: '[State] DUI Attorney · #1 Goal is a Dismissal or Reduction. Get Legal Help From [Firm] Soon' (16.1 per 1,000)
promising, low volume: 'Keep Your License - Call Today'

beats.visual: Selfie-style, attorney walking out of a courthouse, phone held at arm's length.
beats.direction: Natural creator energy, not a commercial read.

beats.voiceover: Your license and job are at stake.
beats.visual: Close-up of a driver's license on a car seat; firm name lower third from 0:02.

beats.voiceover: Our first goal is always a dismissal or a reduction.
beats.visual: Back to the attorney; text bubbles pop in beside the face.
beats.direction: Say 'goal' clearly; this is an aim, not a promise.

beats.voiceover: Text us for a free case evaluation.
beats.visual: Firm name and 'Text us' button graphic, 9:16 safe area.
on_screen_text: Free case evaluation | Text us 24/7 | Attorney advertising [state disclaimer]
beats.direction: Point down at the button. Hold the end card 2 seconds.

specs.cta: Text for a free case evaluation

hook_variants.hook: Worried about your license after a DUI?
Don't talk yourself out of calling a lawyer.

production_notes.script_a: One setup: the attorney at a desk with soft window light, plus 3 b-roll shots (phone, client meeting, review stars). Captions burned in, large, high contrast. Light music bed, under the voice.
production_notes.script_b: Phone-shot selfie, 9:16. Keep text inside the middle 4:5 area so Reels buttons don't cover it. Captions on every line. No music, or a quiet bed.
production_notes.both: Shoot on the same day. Record clean audio even though the text carries the message. Use real reviews only, with names hidden.

test_plan.test: Script A vs a cut that opens with hook variant 2
test_plan.where: YouTube (a Video or Demand Gen campaign)
test_plan.deciding_metric: 25% quartile rate first, then cost per conversion
test_plan.read_after: 1,000+ impressions per version for the hook; conversions before judging cost per conversion
test_plan.read_with: job A of this skill on the Google Ads video results

test_plan.test: Script B with its 3 hook variants as separate ads
test_plan.deciding_metric: hook rate (3-second views ÷ impressions), then hold rate (ThruPlays ÷ 3-second views)
test_plan.read_with: job A of this skill on the Meta account, or facebook-ads-creative-tester (if installed)
